title: Stratum pullback and scalar-extension comparison
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings, and let $i:S\to T$ be an immersion identifying $S$ with a locally closed constructible stratum as in [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], constant ring and module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf], and module inverse image $i^*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For a finite $A$-module $M$, inverse image identifies $i^*\underline M_T\simeq\underline M_S$ as $A_S$-modules, compatibly with addition, negation, zero and scalar multiplication; the coefficient comparison identifies $i^{-1}A_T$ with $A_S$. If $P$ is a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] of $A_T$-modules with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $i^*P$ is K-flat with flat terms and there is a natural termwise tensor comparison [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]
$$i^*(P\otimes_{A_T}B_T)\simeq i^*P\otimes_{A_S}B_S.$$
If the cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] of a complex $K$ restrict to finite locally constant $A_S$-modules on $S$, exact coefficient pullback identifies $\mathcal H^q(i^*K)$ with $i^*\mathcal H^q(K)$ for every $q$.
